# llms.txt - Codebase DNA & Architecture

**Framework**: Next.js 16+
**React**: 19.2+
**Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 (OKLCH)
**Typography**: Swiss Modernist

## Audit Goals
- Transform all pages to >800 words if they are thin content.
- Ensure semantic headings, strict typing, modern RSC patterns, etc.
- See .jules/revolution-plan.json for blueprint details.
